units: <cite ref="Mishnah Demai 1:3">Dem. I, 3</cite> <he>שמן ע׳</he> spiced (perfumed) oil; <cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 6:8">Tosef. Shebi. VI, 8</cite>.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:4:1">Cant. R. to IV, 4</cite> <he>שקולו ע׳</he> because his voice is sweet; a. fr.—Pl. <he>עֲרֵבִים</he>, <he>עֲרֵבִין</he>, <cite ref="P01343"><he>עֲרֵי׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 50:3">Gen. R. s. 50</cite> <he>בשעה … ע׳ להם היו אומרים לו גש הלאה וכ׳</he> when he spoke to them words that pleased them, they said, come near &c.
Ab. Zar. 35ᵃ (ref. to Cant. I, 2) ע׳ עלי דברי דודיך וכ׳ the words of thy friends (the scholars) are sweeter to me than the wine of the Law; a. fr.—Fem. עֲרֵבָה, עֲרֵי׳.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:2">Cant. R. to I, 2</cite> [read:] <he>מה מים … אינן ערבין בגופי כך תורה … אינה ע׳ בגופו</he> as water does not taste well, if one is not thirsty, so it is with the Law, unless a man wearies himself in studying it, he does not get the taste of it; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="P01275"><he>עֲרֵבוֹת</he></cite>, <cite ref="P01343"><he>עֲרֵי׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:11:5">Ib. to V, 11</cite> (play on <he>כעֹרֵב</he>, <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:11:5">ib.</cite>) <he>ע׳ הן עלי</he> they are pleasing to me.
